_note: Stages run roughly in this order, and depends_on may never point at a later one. The router picks a workflow, not a stage: a request may legitimately jump backwards.

discuss.description: Talking it through. Nothing is written to the project yet.

design.description: Deciding what the game is and writing it down: loops, levels, story and its actual dialogue lines, screens, numbers. Produces documents and text, never binary asset files.

define.description: Writing down a style bible so later stages have one source of truth.

architect.description: Deciding how the code is shaped -- boundaries, schemas, formats -- before any of it is written.

audit.description: Walking the project to find out which assets are actually needed.

generate.description: Producing binary asset files -- images, audio, models, clips -- from an audited checklist. Never written text, design documents or code.

integrate.description: Putting produced assets into the game project.

verify.description: Finding out whether what was built actually works and feels right, on a build that already exists. Reports findings; changes nothing.

ship.description: Getting a build out to players.
